items.title: Spain transport minister Óscar Puente quits 6 days after train disaster kills 69
items.author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
items.description: Spain’s transport minister Óscar Puente resigned after a high-speed train collision near Madrid caused 69 fatalities. This incident was the second major rail disaster on the Madrid-Seville route in just one year. Following the October 28 crash, Puente faced pressure from opposition politicians and railway unions demanding his resignation. He acknowledged responsibility for the accidents and announced measures to improve railway safety.

items.title: Oil edges down as investors await US midterm election results
items.description: Oil prices decreased due to investor caution ahead of the US midterm elections and ongoing peace negotiations. Brent futures and West Texas Intermediate crude both saw declines despite an unexpected drop in US crude stocks. Vote counting for the midterm elections continues, which may influence the Republican party's control of Congress. Peace talks in the Middle East were also impacted, especially involving the US and Iran.

items.author: TOI TECH DESK
items.description: Mustafa Suleyman, the CEO of Microsoft AI, maintains that current AI systems are not conscious and lack rights. He emphasized that credible evidence must be publicly disclosed if AI consciousness is proven. Suleyman argues that creating conscious AI poses risks and suggests halting development if signs of consciousness emerge. He asserts the importance of prioritizing human welfare over the potential creation of conscious digital beings.

items.title: Starting November 16, Apple’s new App Store rule bars minors from certain apps
items.author: TOI TECH DESK
items.description: Apple is set to implement more stringent rules for the App Store on November 16, 2026, particularly for dating applications and AI companions. All such applications will require an 18+ age rating, and developers must submit content descriptors by January 12, 2027. This rollout is part of an initiative to bolster child safety and mitigate privacy issues linked to location-sharing features, impacting many well-known AI companion applications worldwide.

items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: In Bihar's Nalanda district, Anita Devi ventured into mushroom farming to uplift her family's financial situation. Initially faced with skepticism from her community, her unwavering dedication culminated in the formation of the Madhopur Farmers Producers Company, which by 2025 embraced 512 farmers and provided vital agricultural resources. Devi's initiative has empowered local women and promoted self-sufficiency, with aspirations to expand into diverse produce like makhana.

items.title: Explained: Why Sebi wants mutual fund investors to switch to direct plans
items.description: Sebi has directed mutual fund houses to make direct plans the default option on digital platforms. This change will take effect from November 1, when investors will see direct plans pre-selected for investment. Direct plans have lower expense ratios compared to regular plans, benefiting long-term investors through compounded returns. These changes aim to reduce conflicts of interest associated with higher commission payments in regular plans.
